races.name: Gold & Silver Exchange Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
LUMINOUS WARRIOR has a shorter trip to contend with but is in good form and remains well treated under a penalty for last week's course success. Shades of May has a more experienced amateur taking the reins this time and is second choice ahead of Serena Brotherton's mount So Grateful.

  1. LUMINOUS WARRIOR (IRE)
  2. SHADES OF MAY
  3. SO GRATEFUL

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SPEED OF SOUND has achieved more than enough to think she can win a race like this and is preferred to Minkaas, who shaped well when fourth on her Bath debut at the start of the summer. Pure Majesty met some trouble in running when behind the selection on her Newmarket debut and could also improve enough to play a prominent role.

  1. SPEED OF SOUND (IRE)
  2. MINKAAS (IRE)
  3. PURE MAJESTY (IRE)

races.name: Strawberry Fields Stud Nursery
races.verdict:
A tight-looking nursery in which DUBAI CHARM is selected to overcome a 7 lb rise for last month's C&D success. Second choice is Troublesome Guest, who had an excuse on her nursery debut and may be suited by the drop to 5f given the speed she showed when allowed to stride on in a couple of her starts.

  1. DUBAI CHARM (IRE)
  2. TROUBLESOME GUEST (IRE)
  3. BEAUTY BOX (IRE)

races.name: Origin Amenity Solutions Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks an excellent opportunity for LIBERATE unless newcomers State Express and/or Time Thief turn out to be above average.

  1. LIBERATE (FR)
  2. STATE EXPRESS (IRE)
  3. TIME THIEF (IRE)

races.name: Brandfords Restaurant & Bars Handicap
races.verdict:
HIGHLAND HARVEY cemented the positive start made for his new yard when scoring in good style over 11.5f here 3 weeks ago and is fancied to continue the good work back in a handicap over this longer trip. Le Rouge Chinois is potentially very interesting having rejoined Mick Appleby and the booking of Tom Marquand firmly catches the eye, whilst Urban Warrior is another fancied to be thereabouts.

  1. HIGHLAND HARVEY (IRE)
  2. LE ROUGE CHINOIS (DEN)
  3. URBAN WARRIOR

races.name: Bet Central Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
PURE PASSION displayed plenty of speed in a pair of all-weather novice contests around the turn of the year and with her reappearance run at Southwell best overlooked, she could be worth siding with on her first try in classified company. Cabeza de Llave and Banana head up the dangers, along with Charging Bull.

  1. PURE PASSION
  2. CABEZA DE LLAVE
  3. BANANA

races.name: Honda Wakefield Super-N Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
GLITTER CODE's tendency to start slowly tempers enthusiasm to a degree but he's not been seen to best effect either start since his promising stable debut second at Beverley in the spring and could be worth chancing to gain a belated breakthrough success. Last year's winner Star Start and Sunny Orange arrive in good heart and look sure to be in the shake up also.

  1. GLITTER CODE (IRE)
  2. STAR START (IRE)
  3. SUNNY ORANGE (IRE)

races.name: Jayne - On Course Lady Bookmaker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ROCK STEADY BEAT was disappointing given the promise he'd displayed previously when third in a Redcar novice in June but gelded subsequently, this looks a good opportunity for Karl Burke's charge to get back on the up from the plum draw in stall 1. Our Son Oscar and Bugzy are a couple of newcomers to note, whilst Lady Henshaw rates a likely improver with her debut run behind her.

  1. ROCK STEADY BEAT (IRE)
  2. OUR SON OSCAR (IRE)
  3. BUGZY

races.name: RIU Hotels And Resorts Ladies Day Veterans' Handicap
races.verdict:
After an encouraging return, SPIRIT GENIE has had excuses both starts since so he could be ready to get back to winning ways as he drops in grade. In a change of headgear, he gets the vote ahead of Garden Oasis who was only narrowly denied on his latest outing.

  1. SPIRIT GENIE (IRE)
  2. GARDEN OASIS
  3. ALESSIA FERNANDA (IRE)

races.name: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
races.verdict:
BETWEENTHESTICKS is taken to land this race for the second year in succession. Great has shaped better than the result on both starts since his Carlisle success last month and is second choice ahead of Spirit of Applause, who has dipped to his lowest mark since scoring at Southwell last September.

  1. BETWEENTHESTICKS
  2. GREAT
  3. SPIRIT OF APPLAUSE

races.name: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap
races.verdict:
ALFA WHITEBURD arrives in top form and has won off this revised mark as a 3-y-o, so is taken to complete a hat-trick at the main expense of Uppercase and The Good Biscuit, who are also bidding for the 3-timer.

  1. ALFA WHITEBURD (IRE)
  2. UPPERCASE
  3. THE GOOD BISCUIT

races.name: Napoleons Casino Bradford Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SOMETHING is holding his form well for his new yard and this looks a good opportunity to resume winning ways providing his stamina holds out over this much longer trip. Division Day is preferred to Anzac Day for forecast purposes.

  1. SOMETHING
  2. DIVISION DAY
  3. ANZAC DAY (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery
races.verdict:
CROWNED's opening mark looks a fair one given what he showed in a couple of maidens, so gets the vote with Colin Keane an eye-catching booking. Tallahassee Lassie justified market confidence when making a winning nursery debut at Ffos Las with a bit in hand 3 weeks ago so looks the obvious threat, while Its A Ginger Thing is a potential improver switched to nurseries.

  1. CROWNED (IRE)
  2. TALLAHASSEE LASSIE
  3. ITS A GINGER THING (IRE)

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
CHYMBULAK stands out in this maiden being a brother to connections' Queen Elizabeth II Stakes and Prix Jacques le Marois winner Charyn. Off The Peg can be expected to step up on his Newbury debut so rates the main threat, while Ahmadi and Minzazi are also newcomers to note.

  1. CHYMBULAK (IRE)
  2. OFF THE PEG (IRE)
  3. AHMADI (IRE)

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
CLIVE THE WRITER showed plenty to work on in what is a traditionally a strong Newbury novice and he can put that experience to good use up against some interesting newcomers, notably Ghost Raider and Dover Street.

  1. CLIVE THE WRITER (IRE)
  2. GHOST RAIDER (IRE)
  3. DOVER STREET (IRE)

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The form of BLACK CHIFFON's debut win at Salisbury in October has worked out well so she shades the vote in what could turn out to be a good novice. C&D winner Gavriel is also making his first start of the year and has the profile to do much better, while Colonnade made a promising start when third at Windsor last month.

  1. BLACK CHIFFON
  2. GAVRIEL
  3. COLONNADE (IRE)

races.name: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DIALSTONE was motoring at the finish when narrowly denied at Ffos Las on his debut in June and is fancied to show the benefit of that initial experience by going one better, probably at the chief expense of choicely-bred newcomer Fortutudine, who represents powerful connections. Purple Moon has to concede plenty of weight but is likely to progress further for his new yard.

  1. DIALSTONE
  2. FORTITUDINE (IRE)
  3. PURPLE MOON (IRE)

races.name: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
CLOUD FOREST improved from his debut effort when beaten only by a promising newcomer at Leicester last month and he can continue his progress to open his account. Cuff It also stepped forward from his first run when scoring at Windsor in June and is feared most, ahead of Church Wedding.

  1. CLOUD FOREST
  2. CUFF IT (FR)
  3. CHURCH WEDDING (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
JUMEIRAH SANDS has shown promise when making the frame both starts in handicaps despite not being seen to best effect, so she could be ready to resume winning ways. Victory Ace isn't taken lightly, though, arriving on the back of his second all-weather success, with Doodling also in the mix.

  1. JUMEIRAH SANDS
  2. VICTORY ACE
  3. DOODLING

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
races.verdict:
DESERT BELLE has improved gradually in defeat since switched to handicaps this year and with her stamina now tested further, she looks to hold sound claims equipped with first-time cheekpieces. Yarmouth scorer Captain Robert rates next best ahead of top weight Tuba.

  1. DESERT BELLE
  2. CAPTAIN ROBERT
  3. TUBA

races.name: JenningsBet Over 200 Shops Nationwide Handicap
races.verdict:
LOVE ALIVE takes a handy drop in class on the back of a fairly encouraging stable debut third at Thirsk 12 days ago and she's fancied to build on that operating 7 lb below her last winning mark. Cape Toronada and Havana Jag are fellow in-form sorts fancied to feature.

  1. LOVE ALIVE
  2. CAPE TORONADA (FR)
  3. HAVANA JAG

races.name: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
ROVINIA is going through a good spell at present and she appeals as the most solid option. River Wharfe ran better than for a while at Windsor on his most recent outing and is considered the main threat on his return to classified company. Rainbow Sign can fill the places if bouncing back from a below-par effort at Lingfield.

  1. ROVINIA
  2. RIVER WHARFE
  3. RAINBOW SIGN

races.name: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap
races.verdict:
SILCA BAY arrives in top form having won 2 of his last 3 starts, able to come from last to first at Newmarket on his latest outing, and is taken to score again in current mood. Tex is feared most with the step back up in trip promising to suit, ahead of C&D winner Play Me.

  1. SILCA BAY
  2. TEX (FR)
  3. PLAY ME

races.name: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
races.verdict:
BUCKLAND BELLE rates easily the most solid in this field on the back of success at Leicester 2 weeks ago and she's fancied to prove tough to contain from a 6 lb higher mark over this longer trip. Port Darwin has had excuses of late and can be seen to better effect here, with veteran Annexation completing the dangers.

  1. BUCKLAND BELLE
  2. PORT DARWIN (IRE)
  3. ANNEXATION (FR)

races.name: JenningsBet 'We Love Brighton Racecourse' 'Confined' Handicap
races.verdict:
Three-time course winner HAVANA MOJITO has finished runner-up on his last 4 starts, bumping into an in-form rival at Doncaster on his latest outing, and is taken to open his account for the year this time around. Viking Glory could be the main danger having been finding his feet for James Owen, with The Organiser also considered.

  1. HAVANA MOJITO
  2. VIKING GLORY (IRE)
  3. THE ORGANISER

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
STARSONG has dipped below her last winning mark and suggested she may be ready to capitalise when finding only one too good on her latest outing at Pontefract 10 days ago. She shades preference over 4-time C&D winner Secret Handsheikh and Faustus, who is down to a handy mark himself.

  1. STARSONG (IRE)
  2. SECRET HANDSHEIKH
  3. FAUSTUS

races.name: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
races.verdict:
TAJ CROWN went close in a maiden at Ballinrobe recently and may prove the answer to this opening claimer. Timandi has been running well in similar races of late and is second choice ahead of Dark Summit, who is a possible class act at this level, and the reappearing Capital Theory.

  1. TAJ CROWN (IRE)
  2. TIMANDI (IRE)
  3. DARK SUMMIT

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Connacht Oaks Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
CORNELIENNE is potentially on a good mark on her French form so gets the vote after a couple of encouraging runs over hurdles. With rain forecast, Spanish Temptress may emerge as the biggest threat ahead of the thriving Thatwilldoso.

  1. CORNELIENNE (IRE)
  2. SPANISH TEMPTRESS (IRE)
  3. THATWILLDOSO (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden
races.verdict:
LADY PATRONA is proving consistent rather than progressive but she sets a clear standard in a very ordinary maiden. The Green Helmet and Tango Club both offered something to work with starting out, so are feared most.

  1. LADY PATRONA
  2. THE GREEN HELMET (IRE)
  3. TANGO CLUB (IRE)

races.name: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
TATIANNA was well on top at the line when making a winning nursery debut at Down Royal, so she's taken to follow up over this extra 1f. Mr Montauk was denied a clear run when third behind the selection that day and is entitled to finish a good deal closer on 6 lb better terms, while Hi Corbett Court showed up well in a competitive event at Cork recently.

  1. TATIANNA (IRE)
  2. MR MONTAUK (IRE)
  3. HI CORBETT COURT (IRE)

races.name: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
In a race where few arrive with compelling claims the fact GLEN BREEZE has a recent win to his name counts for plenty. Billy Lee's mount Dubai Opulence has fewer convictions than most of these and is next on the list ahead of Jampa Ling and Countertop.

  1. GLEN BREEZE (IRE)
  2. DUBAI OPULENCE (IRE)
  3. JAMPA LING (IRE)

races.name: Guinness Handicap
races.verdict:
MARE CRISIUM got back on the up when fourth on her handicap debut at Ballinrobe 16 days ago and could be the answer if building on that effort over this longer trip. Chicago Moon and Private Larry head the dangers.

  1. MARE CRISIUM (IRE)
  2. CHICAGO MOON (IRE)
  3. PRIVATE LARRY (IRE)

races.name: Rockshore Cider Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
DELUCA CHOP is taken to defy the handicapper again and complete a hat-trick. Without Love posted 2 good runner-up efforts last month and heads the dangers along with Young Churchill and Mystic Rose.

  1. DELUCA CHOP (FR)
  2. WITHOUT LOVE
  3. YOUNG CHURCHILL (IRE)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Kenilworth Welcomes You Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
EL COHETE couldn't meet market expectations last time, but looks worth another chance. Rust Never Sleeps is another who could play a big role in proceedings, while Bolero is also in the mix for the placings.

  1. EL COHETE (SAF)
  2. RUST NEVER SLEEPS (SAF)
  3. BOLERO (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Book Of Poseidon Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
MIND OVER YOU ran well first time out and has abundant potential. Sabre Wing could provide the sternest threat, while Royal Emulation is perhaps the most interesting other runner in the line up.

  1. MIND OVER YOU (SAF)
  2. SABRE WING (SAF)
  3. ROYAL EMULATION (SAF)

races.name: Join The Passion Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
AFRICAN WILD DOG has marginally the best all-round profile and looks the one to side with. It'sgood It'snice rates the main danger, while Big Deal is another that could go well.

  1. AFRICAN WILD DOG (SAF)
  2. IT'SGOOD IT'SNICE (SAF)
  3. BIG DEAL (SAF)

races.name: Join The Race Coast Turf Club Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
ODDS AND EVENS is hard to oppose on the back of another solid second place finish 4 weeks ago. Be Rational is second choice, while What The Fluff looks third best.

  1. ODDS AND EVENS (SAF)
  2. BE RATIONAL (SAF)
  3. WHAT THE FLUFF (SAF)

races.name: Bet With Tote www.tote.co.za Class 4 (F & M)
races.verdict:
DREAM SEARCHER was much improved on her latest start and will be tough to beat. Eisteddfod can also play a significant role, while Hampstead Heath merits respect as well.

  1. DREAM SEARCHER (SAF)
  2. EISTEDDFOD (SAF)
  3. HAMPSTEAD HEATH (SAF)

races.name: Race Coast Incentives Powered By Hollywoodbets D Stakes
races.verdict:
MISS NEW YORK appeals best of these by a narrow margin. Midway can also play a leading role also, while Kisses might be tough to keep out of the minor places.

  1. MISS NEW YORK (SAF)
  2. MIDWAY (SAF)
  3. KISSES (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Lightning Roulette Class 5
races.verdict:
AVIGNON is just about the best here and earns preference over Vivo Per Lei. Vercicat isn't dismissed lightly either.

  1. AVIGNON (SAF)
  2. VIVO PER LEI (SAF)
  3. VERCICAT (SAF)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Bright Future Class 4
races.verdict:
LIKE DYNAMITE has a significant edge on form and is hard to oppose. Cork Bay may be the one for second, while Catwalk King also seems unlikely to be far away.

  1. LIKE DYNAMITE (SAF)
  2. CORK BAY (SAF)
  3. CATWALK KING (SAF)

races.name: Prix Hotel Des Ventes Du Bassin D'arcachon (jg Larrieu) Handicap
Prix Du Chateau Lacroix De Mouchet - Montagne Saint Emilion Handicap
Prix Du President Jl Hiss-prix Honneur Aux Pompiers Et Aux Benevoles Maiden Stakes
Prix Du Chateau De Chantegrive Handicap
Prix  Du Chateau D'arche - Sauternes, Grand Cru Classe 1855 Handicap
Prix Du Bar Des Sports - Attele
Prix Laiterie De Saint-malo-groupe Sill - Attele
Grand National Du Trot-ville De St-malo - Attele
Prix Andre Carrus / Ds Store Saint-malo - Attele
Race 1 - A. P. Smithwick Memorial Handicap - Grade 1
